messages:
maria: Heads up — scheduling a remote PDU firmware flash across three regions next Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. This will be staggered rack-by-rack; goal is no hard evictions but expect brief placement delays.
kevin: Which racks / pools are in the first cohort? Any dedicated pools affected?
maria: First cohort: eu-west2-rack-07, us-east1-rack-12. Affected pools: gradient-hosted-gpu (low-risk), dedicated-small (may see reduced throughput). We will avoid core-dedicated and tenant-reserved racks during business hours.
dan: Proposal: 1 rack per AZ, 30m flash window + 15m health-check + warm backfill 30m. Throttle scheduler to 50% new pods for 10m after each rack comes back.
carla: For safety, switch heavy inference routes to the quantized fallback model variant when pool capacity <60%. Add a short-lived routing rule for the 2h peak.
sre-bot: incident-template:maintenance PDU-flash posted: https://runbook/internal/maintenance/pdu-flash.ps1 :white_check_mark:
maria: Rollout plan snippet:
```
02:00 UTC eu-west2-rack-07 -> drain soft -> flash -> health-checks (nvlink, power, BMC) -> uncordon -> warm-backfill
02:45 UTC us-east1-rack-12 -> same
03:30 UTC apac1-rack-05 -> same
Canary: run synthetic QPS + nvlink loop on eu-west2-rack-07 before wider rollout.
```
kevin: Add these kube knobs for drain: `kubectl cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=300 --timeout=30m`. Also bump eviction threshold to 10% during the window to avoid premature OOM evictions.
dan: I'll run the canary at 02:00 and monitor tail latency and restart counts. If restart-count > 5 in 10m, abort and rollback.
ops-runbook: Draft customer comm posted to #customer-success: "We plan a non-disruptive firmware update; customers may see minor throughput degradation for a few minutes. No forced restarts expected." Please review.
carla: Cost note — we will likely spin up ~20 extra on-demand GPU minutes for warm-backfill across regions; rough estimate $4k gross for the window. Finance: we can charge to infra-maint budget or use burst credits?
maria: Finance flagged; I'll request burst credits. Also adding rollback steps: if PDU flash fails, move power to redundant PDU and reflash next slot + mark rack as deferred.
kevin: Ops checklist posted to runbook. Quick health tests to include: `nvlink-test --loop 1000`, `gpu-smoketest --model small`, and `curl /healthz` for inference endpoints.
dan: On-call: @kevin please stand by from 01:45-06:30 UTC.
carla: :thumbsup: Also add a temporary routing fallback to cpu-quantized models for requests with >150ms tail latency.
maria: Final: update the scheduler auto-scaler policy to hold scale-ins for 20m post-evac to avoid churn. Will post final runbook link 12h before window.
ops-runbook: Published final comm and runbook link: https://runbook/internal/maintenance/pdu-flash-final. Please ACK."
